q1.question: What is web hosting and why do I need it?
q1.answer: Web hosting stores your site files and makes them accessible online. Your domain points visitors to your site; hosting publishes it.

q2.question: How do I purchase a hosting plan?
q2.answer: Select a plan, add it to cart, and complete checkout. After payment, your hosting account is provisioned automatically.

q3.question: Can I migrate my existing website?
q3.answer: Yes. All plans include free migration support. Our team will guide you through the process.

q4.question: Should I use cPanel or Plesk?
q4.answer: cPanel is popular and beginner-friendly. Plesk excels at multi-site and Windows workloads. Each plan shows its panel type.

forms.licenseKeysHelp: Each purchase consumes the next key. Leave empty to auto-generate.
forms.promoTextPlaceholder: Short product pitch shown after purchase
forms.hostingServerHelp: Provisioning for this plan runs on the selected servers.
forms.hostingServersHelp: Select one or more servers. Failover fills them in priority order when a sales limit is reached; Balanced spreads new accounts across servers with free capacity.
forms.pleskServersHelp: These servers provision hosting and run auto-deploy (Docker + Apache proxy). Panel URL must match the node where accounts are created.
forms.autoDeployEnabledHelp: Customers on this plan can deploy from GitHub. Requires Plesk and at least one linked server above.
forms.autoDeployRequiresPlesk: Auto-deploy is only available on Plesk plans
forms.serverPriorityHelp: Top server is used first. When its sales limit is full, the next one is used.
forms.distributionFailoverHelp: Fill the first server until its max accounts limit, then move to the next.
forms.distributionBalancedHelp: Always provision on the server with the fewest accounts (among those under the limit).
forms.pleskPlanNameHelp: Must match an existing service plan on the Plesk server. Leave empty to use server defaults.
forms.hostingServerRequired: Select at least one hosting server for this plan.
forms.noHostingServersForPanel: No active servers for this panel. Add one under Hosting Servers first.
forms.noLinkedHostingPlans: No hosting plans linked to a server yet. Create a plan and assign a server.

forms.panelApiSectionHint: Used for provisioning, mail, and Plesk XML API — not for SSH deploy.
